decisions.reason: The required relocation of the two letter photos is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source changes the cover letter's signature handling and specific photo placement, not the established full-document layout approach.
Signature insertion and relocation of two photos do not change the typography consistency rules or resolve the bolding ambiguity.
The source does not change the background treatment required for the identified special pages.
The source does not alter the Blue Mesa brand identity, logo, or color requirements.
The cover-letter edits do not affect inclusion or placement of the organization chart.
Requesting easy signature insertion in Canva does not change the existing access, ownership, or asset-policy requirements.
Moving two photos to another section if necessary does not authorize reordering the fixed RFQ sections.
The source contains no change to table integration, table replacements, or the approved table source.
The cover-letter formatting and photo-placement changes do not modify the requirement that final-file hyperlinks remain functional.
Relocating photos between sections does not change required section content or resolve whether Section 11 belongs in the proposal.
The one-page cover-letter constraint was already established separately, and this source does not change the overall 34-page limit or spacing policy.
